about.title: About Us
about.heroDescription: A free, collaborative encyclopedia dedicated to the scholars and thinkers of the Islamic intellectual tradition.
about.introLeft: Oulamauna was created with a clear purpose: to preserve the lives and works of the scholars who shaped Islamic thought, and to make that knowledge easy to find, read, and pass on.
about.introRight: With years of care behind every entry, our contributors are driven by respect for scholarship and a love of the tradition they document.
about.whatBody: We gather biographies, manuscripts, and academic references into one multilingual archive.
about.archiveP1: Every entry brings together a scholar's biography, notable works, and available manuscripts in one place — in Arabic, English, and French.
about.archiveP2: To keep entries reliable, we ask contributors to cite their sources, and every submission passes a review before it goes live.
about.accessBody: At Oulamauna, openness is at the heart of what we do. We believe scholarly heritage should be easy to reach and easy to understand.
about.accessSub: That's why every entry is free to read in three languages, so no single language limits who can learn from it.
about.teamBody: Our contributors aren't just adding names — they're researchers and readers with a deep respect for the tradition they document. Their care for sources and accuracy is what keeps the archive trustworthy.
about.ctaTitle: Have a correction, a scholar to suggest, or a question about the archive? We'd love to hear from you.
